title: HYDRA on Radix DLT: The Community Memecoin Burning Its Way Up
excerpt: Launched on February 8, 2026, HYDRA is a 100% community-owned memecoin on Radix DLT with weekly burns of 100,000 tokens and a live ecosystem.
content:
## What Is HYDRA?

HYDRA is a community-driven memecoin built natively on **Radix DLT**, one of the most technically advanced distributed ledger networks in the world. Launched on **February 8, 2026**, HYDRA was created with a single founding principle: 100% community ownership. There was no presale, no team allocation, no venture capital. Every token has always belonged to the community.

In a market crowded with projects that promise the world and deliver nothing, HYDRA stands out for a different reason. It is building a real, functioning ecosystem — and doing it transparently, on-chain, on Radix.

## Tokenomics Built for Scarcity

Understanding HYDRA starts with its tokenomics, which are refreshingly straightforward. The total supply created was **1,000,000,000 HYDRA** — one billion tokens. Of those, approximately **965,600,000 HYDRA** are currently in circulation. The difference represents tokens already removed from existence through the project's core mechanic: the weekly burn.

Every single week, **100,000 HYDRA tokens are permanently burned** — sent to a dead address with no way back. There is no complex governance vote, no quarterly decision. It simply happens, on-chain, every week. At this rate, the project removes over **5,200,000 tokens from circulation every year**. That is not a promise or a whitepaper projection. That is math executing itself publicly on the Radix ledger.

The distribution is equally clean: **100% community**. No team wallet quietly dumping tokens. No VC allocation waiting to exit. Every wallet holding HYDRA is a community wallet.

## Why Radix DLT?

Most memecoins launch on Ethereum, Solana, or BNB Chain because those are the easiest paths. HYDRA chose **Radix DLT** — and that choice reflects a different kind of ambition.

Radix is built from the ground up for decentralized finance. Its asset-oriented programming model treats tokens as first-class citizens of the protocol, not smart contract workarounds prone to bugs and exploits. The result is a chain where assets behave predictably, where DeFi applications are safer to build, and where the infrastructure is designed to scale without sacrificing the principles of decentralization. For a community project that wants to last, launching on Radix is a statement about the kind of future it is building toward.

## A Live Ecosystem, Not a Roadmap

This is where HYDRA separates itself from the majority of memecoins that exist only as promises on a PDF. Every product in the HYDRA ecosystem is **already live and operational**.

**[HydraSwap](https://hydraxrd.com/swap)** is the decentralized exchange where HYDRA is traded. It runs on Radix DLT and is fully operational right now. No centralized intermediary, no order book controlled by a third party — pure peer-to-peer swapping on-chain. If you want to buy HYDRA, this is where you go.

**HydraBurn** is the engine behind the weekly token burns. Every week, 100,000 HYDRA are permanently removed from circulation through this program. The process is transparent and verifiable by anyone on the Radix ledger.

**HydraBubbles**, **HydraBattleArena**, and **HydraTrack** round out the ecosystem, each adding a different dimension to how community members engage with the project. All three are live. All three are accessible to HYDRA holders today.

Five products. All running. All built on Radix. That level of execution from a community memecoin less than a year old is genuinely rare.

## A Small Community With Real Conviction

HYDRA is honest about where it stands. This is an **early-stage community project**, not a billion-dollar protocol. The Telegram has around **120 members**. The [X account](https://x.com/hydraxrd) has around **290 followers**. These numbers are small by the standards of the memecoin market.

But they represent something more valuable than inflated follower counts: a real community that understands what it holds, participates in burn events, uses [HydraSwap](https://hydraxrd.com/swap), and engages with the ecosystem. Quality has always mattered more than quantity in the early stages of any crypto project.

Every major memecoin in history started from a small, tight-knit group of true believers. Dogecoin was two developers making a joke. Pepe was a niche forum meme. The ones that survived and grew were carried by communities with genuine conviction — and that is exactly what HYDRA is building.

## How to Buy HYDRA

The process is straightforward. First, get a Radix wallet by downloading the official app from the [Radix website](https://radixdlt.com). Then acquire some XRD — the native token of Radix DLT — which is available on major centralized exchanges. Finally, head to [HydraSwap](https://hydraxrd.com/swap) and swap your XRD for HYDRA. The transaction is instant and fully on-chain.

HYDRA is **not listed on any centralized exchange**. It trades exclusively through [HydraSwap](https://hydraxrd.com/swap) on Radix DLT. This is by design — a community-owned token, traded on a community-built DEX, on a chain built for the long term.

## What HYDRA Does Not Claim to Be

Transparency is a core value of this project, so it is worth being direct. HYDRA does not have millions of daily transactions or deep liquidity pools — it is early-stage and honest about that. It is not listed on Binance, Coinbase, or any centralized exchange. Its total supply is one billion tokens, not a trillion. And like all speculative crypto assets, it makes no guarantee of returns.

Any source claiming otherwise is inaccurate. The truth is verifiable on-chain, and the HYDRA community encourages everyone to check for themselves.

## The Bigger Picture

Memecoins have proven one thing consistently across every cycle: community is the product. The technology can be copied, the ticker can be cloned, but a genuine community that organizes itself, burns tokens every week, ships working products, and holds real conviction cannot be easily replicated.

HYDRA launched six months ago. It already has five live products, a functioning DEX, a consistent weekly burn program, and a growing community on one of the most technically serious chains in the space. That is a foundation worth paying attention to. The meme is the entry point. The ecosystem is the reason to stay.
